responsibility: This implementation module parses a DynamicStrings.String command line into argument slices by skipping whitespace and scanning quoted or unquoted spans. Rather than copying into ARRAY OF CHAR buffers, it returns arguments as String slices and counts them with the same scanning logic, making it the String-based companion to CmdArgs for textual command-line tokenization.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the parser implementation for the SCmdArgs pair: unlike SCmdArgs.def, it implements the token scanner with helpers for whitespace and quoted spans, then returns arguments as DynamicStrings slices from the source command string.
